component.name: Cast Desktop
component.summary: Stream Linux desktop and audio to Chromecast devices

description.p: Cast Desktop is a high-performance utility for streaming your Linux desktop display and PipeWire/PulseAudio sound to Google Chromecast, Android TV, and Google Cast-enabled speakers.

ul.li: Fragmented MP4 (fMP4/CMAF) HTTP Live Streaming optimized for modern Google TV and Chromecast receivers.
Hardware-accelerated video encoding via VA-API on AMD and Intel GPUs.
Configurable latency presets: Ultra-Low (0.5s), Balanced (1.0s), and Cinema (2.0s).
Multi-monitor and individual application window capture.
Audio-only casting to smart speakers and Google Home.
System tray StatusNotifierItem integration with volume scroll and playback controls.
Responsive HTML5 Web Remote and QR code generator for smartphone control.
Visual glowing border overlay framing active screen capture areas.
Native desktop menu integration and global keyboard shortcuts.

description.p: Implemented VA-API hardware acceleration, system tray icon, web remote, latency presets, multi-monitor/window selector, and TV controls.
Added desktop menu launcher, custom branding logo, and Debian packaging.
